summary_md:
# VD-byten och svaga laxrapporter

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode opens November with a cautious market backdrop. Nasdaq fell after weak Amazon earnings, Chinese macro data was soft, Brent oil was still high at about USD 110 despite news of Iran talks, the US midterms were a risk, and Riksbanken was expected to raise rates. Against that, Swedish manufacturing PMI hit its highest level since January 2022, which the hosts saw as a sign of strong industrial demand even though stocks have not been rewarded for it. Company talk centred on CEO changes (Apple, Studsvik, Atlas Antibodies), weak Bakkafrost results that the CEO defended, AcadeMedia's slowing growth combined with a low valuation, consultants turning optimistic, Silex lock-up expiries and the week's reporting companies (Skanska, Cloetta, Apotea).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 SKA-B — Skanska | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host likes Skanska ahead of Thursday's report: strong US construction and data-centre orders, but wants office properties sold.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion: Skanska benefits from strong US construction and is winning many data-centre orders. The weak spot is capital tied up in commercial and office properties. The host wants to see property sales, even below book value, so capital can be recycled into construction. Data-centre commentary is also worth watching given AI sentiment.

#### Sell Triggers

- no property divestments
- data-centre order cancellations
- weak US construction

> *"Jag gillar Skanska."*

---

### 🟠 CLA-B — Cloetta | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Purest candy play: strong previous report, rising margins, superbrands strategy, US entry. Reports Wednesday.

#### Reasoning

Hosts are positive: Cloetta lifted margins, did well on the stock market and is expanding into the US with bags and pick-and-mix. The risk is sharply higher sugar and cocoa prices squeezing margins. The US business is still too small to matter much.

#### Sell Triggers

- margin compression from sugar/cocoa costs
- weak report on Wednesday

> *"Cloetta är ju liksom det mest rena spelet."*

---

### 🟠 APOTEA — Apotea | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Hosts are not worried by Meds' profit warning; Apotea's warehouse move is done and they think the report may be good.

#### Reasoning

Meds' profit warning was specific to its own distribution move. Apotea has already moved to Varberg and recovered from its earlier dip. Consumer and e-commerce companies have reported well this season, so both hosts expect a good report.

#### Sell Triggers

- profit warning or margin miss
- renewed logistics problems

> *"Jag tror snarare det kan vara en bra rapport."*

---

### 🟠 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Earnings growing but valuation flat at ~10x earnings; hosts call it cheap, held back by political risk. Organic growth slowing.

#### Reasoning

Profit +18% and sales +14%, but organic growth is slowing and upper-secondary margins fell to 4.1%. Hosts note the valuation has not expanded despite earnings growth, about 10x earnings, which they see as cheap in a disliked sector. Political risk around independent schools caps the multiple.

#### Sell Triggers

- regulation against independent schools
- continued organic growth slowdown
- margin decline in upper secondary

> *"Så det är billiga aktier och de gör det bra i kanske lite hatade branscher."*

---

### 🟠 LOOMIS — Loomis | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 40-50% over the year yet still ~9x earnings; today's drop seen as profit-taking.

#### Reasoning

Hosts grouped Loomis with AcadeMedia as cheap stocks doing well in disliked sectors, valued at about 9x earnings. Today's 4-5% drop after a strong report looks like profit-taking.

#### Sell Triggers

- earnings decline
- multiple stays compressed

> *"Fortfarande nio gånger i byta."*

---

### 🟡 BAKKA — Bakkafrost | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Q3 EBIT about half of expectations, stock down 3-6%. CEO expects supply growth near zero, higher salmon prices and a stronger Scotland.

#### Reasoning

This view comes mainly from the CEO, who is biased. Supply growth from Norway falls to about 1% next year, which should lift prices. The US is over 30% of sales and Faroese salmon has a tariff advantage there. The Scotland turnaround is expected within two years. Hosts said 'inte så farligt' and found the CEO positive. Feed costs from El Niño are a risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- salmon prices fail to recover
- Scotland turnaround delayed further
- feed cost inflation

> *"Inte så farligt. Jag tycker ändå att han låter ganska positiv."*

---

### 🟠 AFRY — AFRY | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Report sent the stock higher; plans to net-recruit thousands and sees AI as an opportunity. Consultant sector brightening.

#### Reasoning

Host sees a shift: consultants are backing their AI optimism with strong net hiring plans, which points to improving organic growth. This is part of a reverse-AI trade benefiting companies once seen as AI losers.

#### Sell Triggers

- hiring plans scaled back
- organic growth weakens

> *"Lite ljusning i konsultsektorn."*

---

### 🟠 SWEC-B — Sweco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Dipped slightly after its report, but plans 2-3k net recruits over the coming years; consultant optimism at a multi-quarter high.

#### Reasoning

Same consultant-turnaround thesis as AFRY: aggressive net recruitment signals confidence in demand, and AI is seen as a business opportunity.

#### Sell Triggers

- hiring plans scaled back
- demand weakens

> *"både Sweco och Afry pratade om två-tre tusen under några år här framåt då som de ska netto-rekrytera"*

---

### 🟠 REJL-B — Rejlers | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Reports this week; worth following given the turnaround in consultant peers.

#### Reasoning

Peers AFRY, Knowit and Prevas were rewarded for their reports and are planning net hiring. The host flags Rejlers as one to follow this week.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak organic growth in report

> *"Så det blir intressant att hålla koll på i Rejlus"*

---

### 🟠 NCAB — NCAB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Chairman sold shares just before the capital markets day, which hosts call remarkable.

#### Reasoning

An insider sale by the chairman shortly before the capital markets day is a negative governance and sentiment signal, according to the hosts.

> *"Lite anmärkningsvärt att han vräker ut aktier inför den."*

---

### 🟠 SVIK — Studsvik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO leaves immediately with successor already recruited; hosts suspect internal issues despite nuclear tailwind.

#### Reasoning

The abrupt CEO exit with a pre-recruited successor is unusual. Hosts suspect internal problems, since the company should be benefiting from the nuclear wave. Stock is down sharply over the year.

#### Sell Triggers

- disclosure of internal problems

> *"det kan vara lite interna problem, för man borde ha marknaden med sig just nu när det finns en kärnkraftsvåg"*

---
